Render a Journal-Ready Reproducibility Verification Certificate

Source: R/certificate.R
render_certificate.Rd

Produces a publication-ready Markdown and/or standalone self-contained HTML5 reproducibility verification certificate from an rcapsule_verification audit result. Suitable for journal peer-review supplements, Zenodo/OSF archival packages, and CI reproducibility gates.

Usage

render_certificate(
  verification,
  output = NULL,
  format = c("both", "markdown", "html"),
  title = NULL
)

Arguments

verification

An rcapsule_verification object returned by verify_capsule().

output

Optional base output path (or exact file path when rendering a single format). When format = "both", writes <base>.md and <base>.html. If NULL, returns rendered strings in memory without writing files.

format

Output format: "both" (default), "markdown", or "html".

title

Optional report title. Defaults to "Reproducibility Verification Certificate: <project_name>".

Value

An S3 object of class rcapsule_certificate with fields markdown, html, files (named character vector of written paths), and verification.

Examples

tmp <- tempfile("rcapsule_cert_")
dir.create(tmp)
writeLines("write.csv(data.frame(a = 1:2), 'out.csv', row.names = FALSE)",
           file.path(tmp, "run.R"))
write.csv(data.frame(a = 1:2), file.path(tmp, "out.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
m <- create_capsule_manifest(tmp, outputs = "out.csv", seed = 1L)
v <- verify_capsule(m, path = tmp)
cert <- render_certificate(v, output = file.path(tmp, "certificate"))
cert$files
#>                                                      markdown 
#>   "/tmp/RtmpFZcrpm/rcapsule_cert_18fb75b6a1ba/certificate.md" 
#>                                                          html 
#> "/tmp/RtmpFZcrpm/rcapsule_cert_18fb75b6a1ba/certificate.html" 
unlink(tmp, recursive = TRUE)
